module_summary: Synchronous circular-buffer FIFO: register-array memory with wrapping read/write pointers and an occupancy counter deriving full/empty, with optional fall-through and flush/clear.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: FIFO storage array written at write pointer, read at read pointer.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Push data written into mem at write pointer.

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Push request; writes data and advances write pointer when not full.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Head-of-queue data read from mem at read pointer.

anchors.name: pop_i
anchors.why: Pop request; advances read pointer when not empty.

anchors.name: read_pointer_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting head entry; wraps at depth.

anchors.name: write_pointer_q
anchors.why: Write pointer selecting entry for push; wraps at depth.

anchors.name: status_cnt_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count driving full, empty and usage outputs.

anchors.name: full_o
anchors.why: Full flag from occupancy count; blocks pushes.

anchors.name: empty_o
anchors.why: Empty flag from occupancy count; blocks pops.

anchors.name: usage_o
anchors.why: Fill level output copied from status counter.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush command clearing pointers and count.

anchors.name: clr_or_flush
anchors.why: Combined clear/flush resetting pointers and counter.

anchors.name: gate_clock
anchors.why: Active-low memory write enable, ungated on push.

groups.name: FIFO memory
groups.description: Register array holding queued entries, written on push.

groups.name: Pointer and count control
groups.description: Wrapping read/write pointers and occupancy counter producing full/empty.
